'''''Theta-2Y''''' was a [[B-12 Bacta Transport]] owned by [[Hamar-Chaktak]] through his company, [[Cargo Consolidated, Inc.]] Hamar-Chaktak allied with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to hijack a [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] transport, neglecting to tell them that the transport was one of his and he intended to use its loss as an insurance fraud. Hamar-Chaktak also intended to capture the Rebel [[operative]]s and ransom them to the Alliance for a hefty sum.<ref name="BH" />
